meta.title: 0.6 LABRIG — loop contract and release gates
meta.description: 0.6 LABRIG contract; 2026-09-07 backlog pass adds whole-batch JS syntax preflight, stack-aware failure identity, cumulative reasoning/output limits, versioned implementation guidance and explicit delivery ordering. Memory readiness/query conventions and configured-Core Ignite wake are coordinated dependencies. Current verification/install boundaries: docs/backlog-fixes-2026-09-07.md; original voxel benchmark unmodified and not certified by fixture passes.

frames.label: 1 · Every surface sees the same state

nodes.label: Chat · CLI · RFX
nodes.note: Installed 2026-09-06, revision a3a8367-dirty-45e4ab58c05d. All five private UI backlog items implemented with incumbent identity: quiet sidebar, consecutive successful-read groups retaining full details, compact incidents/technical disclosure, multiline composer/action separation and non-overlay dock seam. Canonical blocked-target stopped status preserved. 101 Vitest tests pass; Svelte has zero errors/eight existing warnings; browser fixtures pass four configurations. Served HTML/JS/CSS match package; model/embedder/Typesense healthy. Core and embedder PIDs unchanged; no original session run triggered.

nodes.label: Settings and controls
nodes.note: Scoped run controls and settings retain prior regression coverage. Real W8A16 follow-up: pause/resume d05abf5aab0bb8fe9080cbe7 PASS (same owner, paused inactivity, competing409); steer a1f0acced785ec0a67aeb1f4 PASS (next request receives instruction, changed marker read back). Isolated sessions, Core unchanged. Evidence: docs/release-0.6-LABRIG.md; internal/api/labrig_controls_test.go.

nodes.label: Command service
nodes.note: Image-bearing commands and raw user-event ingress bounded to 768 KiB. At most two validated inline JPEG/PNG images, <=256 KiB and <=1280 px per axis. Canonical image bytes participate in command identity and msg.user persistence. Session-scoped DevCheck reads require exact path and expected digest; no general file-read route.

nodes.label: Run ownership
nodes.note: Session plus canonical workspace ownership, process file leases, compare-and-release; paused leases retained. All modes conservatively reserve workspace. No queue. Tests: command/runcontrol/snapshot.

nodes.label: Run policy snapshot
nodes.note: Run-local policy and budgets journaled; config writes serialized. Sampling default now defers to Core; explicit overrides and frozen active runs preserved. Live setting saved; source fallback and copy tested, not installed. Evidence: docs/sampling-default-2026-09-05.md. Session overrides outside scope.

nodes.label: Task and plan compiler
nodes.note: Bounded safe DGV planning and local check guidance installed (d706d2b3a3ab). Stored plans unchanged. Local installation receipt retained privately.

nodes.label: Plan supervisor
nodes.note: Installed 619383328f9d: explicit step continue_plan flag and error-aware retry; ordinary step remains single, Selected scope never widened; stale declared-file evidence rechecked before advance. Release gates pass; operator recovery benchmark pending.

nodes.label: Common runner
nodes.note: Implemented and regression-tested bounded recovery memory plus one verified-new-source continuation; no global guard removal or automatic restore. Packed real-Core regional baseline repaired a specific error, rechecked prior work and continued. Actual voxel repair remains unverified; see recovery node and docs/targeted-file-recovery-2026-09-06.md.

nodes.label: Per-run context builder
nodes.note: Installed bounded 6000-byte related-step context retains previously passed shared-file checks as historical/awaiting recheck. Scoped read_plan_step supplies exact immutable plan/check/verdict on demand; tool result receipt IDs are visible for evidence citations. No new current pass is inferred from reading historical state.

nodes.label: Tool dispatcher
nodes.note: Raw guarded patch validation, explicit fields and sequential shadow checks installed. Runtime partial failures disclosed. Local installation receipt retained privately.

nodes.label: Versioned verification
nodes.note: Declared check start/result, raw tool evidence, workspace fingerprint; exact eval boolean including Chromium source suffix; missing checks never pass; downstream revalidation follows edits. Tests: verifyrun/supervisor/selected.

nodes.label: Session workspace services
nodes.note: Canonical session workspace registries and indexing hooks; cache removed and step source reread. Sequential dependency invalidation, not a new filesystem ACL or complete external-input version model.

nodes.label: Existing Brain Core
nodes.note: Existing dependency, not a proposed serving change. Audit tests used fake models. No inference tuning is part of this design.

nodes.label: Durable session event log
nodes.note: Serialized fsynced run/plan/call/verify records with sticky persistence failure. Interrupted crash outcomes tested. Fully normalized attempt/event envelope is a future extension.

nodes.label: Canonical state reducer
nodes.sublabel: live state = replay at every prefix
nodes.note: Snapshot drives run/plan/report/current errors from one prefix. Follow-up 3 removed sameFiles/filesPresent/statOK dead reconciliation. File-existence-cannot-pass tests retained with accurate names/comments/messages; targeted race checks pass before and after. No behavior change.

nodes.label: Snapshot + event stream
nodes.note: Installed9c527991491f. Live report confirms2 stale/1blocked/5pending/0skipped. Served native panel and embeddedPlanner1.5.1 bytes verified. Builtin precedence visible; historical chat reports immutable. Default sampling/Medium autopilot settings preserved.

nodes.label: Incident projection
nodes.note: 0.6 current-run actionable projection, retry Notes, background warnings; history retained. Formal persisted incident.opened/resolved families remain future work, not claimed implemented.

nodes.label: Background jobs
nodes.note: Optional distillation failures are background Notes; no successful foreground run converted to a current error card.

nodes.label: Single session event writer
nodes.note: API writer cache serializes run-scoped appends; persistence stops new effects. Not a universal event-transition validator/migration of every legacy append path.

nodes.label: Recovery contract
nodes.note: Installed a3a8367-dirty-c71e1f303281: evidence-backed verification review preserves original criterion and fresh verdict; no automatic proposal execution/approval. Durable note replay and stale plan fail-closed checks covered by regressions. Original Minecraft run untouched; latest stop was generated 300-face threshold versus observed 256, not service crash.

nodes.label: Observed idle state
nodes.note: Installed localhost:7700 revision a3a8367-dirty-8fdba1cf204e after no-active-run check. Observed service state controls nonmodal parked/waking notices and avoids health HTTP wakes. Full tests and desktop/mobile fixtures pass; live model/embedder/Typesense healthy and served assets match. Existing watchdog changed Core PID during preparation; installer refused, observation reconciled with audit retained, no Core lifecycle commands issued. Backup install-backup-harness-recovery-HuLS5D. See docs/idle-screen-2026-09-06.md. Next actual idle cycle not forced.
